Services

Four services. Done properly.

Every job is handled by EPA- and NATE-certified, factory-trained technicians — and backed in writing.

HVAC Repair

Diagnosis and repair for heating and cooling systems across all five boroughs — with 24-hour emergency availability and a 30-day warranty on emergency repair.

Request repair →

HVAC Installation

Custom system installation for homes and commercial spaces — including VRF and rooftop systems, ductless mini-splits, WSHP, heat pumps, and energy-efficient furnaces — with a 3-year warranty on custom system installation.

Plan an installation →

HVAC Service Contract

Ongoing service contracts that keep building systems maintained and covered — one accountable contractor for the equipment your tenants and customers rely on.

Ask about a contract →

New Construction HVAC

HVAC for new construction projects — systems designed and installed for the buildings New York is putting up now, from rooftop plant to in-unit equipment.

Discuss a project →

Founded by Josh Manny

American HVAC Corp was founded in 2019 by Josh Manny, who brings three decades of HVAC industry expertise dating back to 1996. The company is young; the experience behind it isn't — and more than 2,000 satisfied customers across New York City have the systems to show for it.
